verdict.rationale: Base44 ships an official CLI (installable via npm) documented with commands for creating projects, syncing data models/code, deploying resources, and cloning/ejecting apps, explicitly positioned for AI-native workflows (e.g. 'easy for AI coding agents to build and manage your project'). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the CLI itself (community evidence discusses the web app experience, not CLI usage) and no evidence of CLI extensibility or plugin ecosystem.
